description.value:
You touch a creature and jump-start its body's natural healing, restoring 4d8 + 15 hit points at once. For the rest of the duration, the target regains 1 hit point at the start of each of its turns (10 hit points per minute).

If you hold a severed limb or similar part against the stump while casting, the power immediately reattaches it. Droids and constructs are unaffected.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 7
